nodes.name: Sklearn Cluster KMeans Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level public KMeans-family estimator-selection, callback-boundary, and fitted-state atoms above compiled Lloyd, Elkan, minibatch, and recursive KMeans solver boundaries.

nodes.name: kmeans_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose the public sklearn.cluster KMeans-family estimator names useful for framework-level model selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public estimator-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: kmeans_estimator_backend
nodes.description: Return the native solver boundary family behind a public KMeans estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over three public estimator names.

nodes.name: kmeans_estimator_task
nodes.description: Return the high-level learning task for a public KMeans-family estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates a fixed estimator name and returns the common clustering task label.

nodes.name: kmeans_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level KMeans-family routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom selects one fixed method tuple by estimator name.

nodes.name: kmeans_fit_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public KMeans fit payload for finite dense inputs without executing the native solver.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, sample_weight: object = None) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates finite dense input shape and packages references, leaving optimization to sklearn.

nodes.name: kmeans_prediction_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public KMeans prediction-like method payload without executing the estimator method.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, method_name: str, X: object) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates finite dense prediction input and packages references, leaving prediction execution to sklearn.

nodes.name: kmeans_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted KMeans-family estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: kmeans_fitted_state
nodes.description: Expose fitted centers, labels, inertia, and iteration metadata after the deferred native KMeans solver.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes labels and center arrays already produced by sklearn fitting.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 1 public KMeans-family estimator shells over compiled Lloyd, Elkan, minibatch, and recursive KMeans solver boundaries
limitations: The internal algorithmic topology is obscured by compiled sklearn KMeans solver boundaries.
The shell models finite dense public API routing and fitted-state packaging, not sparse inputs, custom distance behavior, convergence, or centroid-update internals.
